It is frangrance-free, free of parabens, sulfates, phthalates, dyes and ethanol alcohol, reducing the risk of irritation. I have noticed that serums and moisturizers absorb much better after Tricoci Refine Exfoliator, improving overall skincare efficacy. When developing this product, professionals sought input from licensed estheticians, ensuring a balance of effectiveness and skin safety. I applied a thin layer on my clean, dry skin, left it on 5-10 minutes, massaged my face with wet fingertips, activating the polishing beads. I rinse thoroughly and then apply my serums and moisturizers.

Here are a few standout perks: * Deep but Gentle Detox: It effectively pulls out impurities and excess oil without disrupting your skin's natural moisture barrier. * Refreshing Texture: The consistency is smooth and luxurious, making the actual act of washing your face feel like a treat rather than a chore. * Clarifying Results: After consistent use, I noticed my skin looked clearer and felt softer to the touch.
